title: mut.leaf_as_unit
mutation_directive: LEAF AS BASIC UNIT — build the piece treating the LEAF (a curled/folded sheet) as the elemental compositional primitive, the way Tarbell uses dots or Anadol uses data points. Pick ONE innovative leaf-application from this list and execute it deeply: (a) FIGURE-IN-LEAVES — a recognizable silhouette (bird, fish, hand) where the body is composed of overlapping curled leaves at fish-scale density; (b) NAUTILUS LEAF SPIRAL — leaves arranged on a logarithmic spiral, scale increasing outward, golden-ratio rotation; (c) LEAF GLYPHS — each leaf is a typographic character; the cluster spells or suggests a phrase / koan / haiku; (d) GIANT FLOWER — many leaves as petals of one immense bloom, viewer at the heart looking outward; (e) BOOK OPENING — leaves as pages of a turning book, each at a different rotation, time-staggered unfurl; (f) WIND OR FLOOR — a scattered carpet of fallen leaves with directed-wind drift (one direction, smooth); (g) WREATH/GARLAND — architectural ring of leaves around a void-center; (h) VENATION FRACTAL — focus on the leaf SKELETON / vein network as a fractal subdivision pattern; (i) TONGUES OF FIRE — leaves as flickering tongues of warm light, organic but luminous. Render each leaf as a SHEET (ParametricGeometry / BufferGeometry strip with curved midrib), NOT as a Point or Line. Use 50-300 leaf instances with per-instance scale + rotation variation (handmade-feel). Palette: warm-amber/sodium/cream-on-near-black, or autumn-russet (oxide red, ochre, umber, rare green). Slow, intentional motion — leaves breathe, drift, never jitter. The leaf is the new pixel.
